content.title: PENGU is the official coin of Pudgy Penguins.
content.description: Pudgy Penguins has become the face of crypto with one of the most influential communities in the industry. From large companies wearing the Penguin, to being featured in ETF commercials, to garnering millions of followers and over 100 billion views, the Pengu has become a cultural icon making PENGU the world’s social currency.

content.title: About Bitcoin (BTC)
content.description: Bitcoin is the world's first decentralized cryptocurrency that enables peer-to-peer electronic cash transactions without intermediaries like banks or governments.

content.title: About Asteroid Shiba
content.description: Asteroid Shiba is inspired by a real-life event where a Shiba Inu plush toy named "Asteroid" served as a zero-gravity indicator during the Polaris Dawn mission. This connection to space travel gives it a narrative that's both whimsical and grounded in a tangible event, differentiating it from other meme coins which might rely solely on internet culture or celebrity endorsements.

content.title: What is Hyperliquid about?
content.description: Hyperliquid is a layer one (L1) blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Beyond its flagship DEX trading platform, the ecosystem supports borrowing, lending, real world assets (RWAs), and a full-fledged Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), making it a leading force in decentralized finance (defi).

content.title: About Ethereum
content.description: Ethereum is a blockchain platform that enables developers to build and deploy smart contracts and decentralized applications, operating through thousands of independent nodes worldwide rather than through a central authority.

content.title: About Zebec Network
content.description: Zebec's integrated products, including real-time payroll apps, on-chain payments infrastructure, and networked DePIN, serve companies of all sizes, merchants, and individuals, helping to transcend the boundaries of traditional banking and diminish the role of financial intermediaries.

content.title: About Pi Network (PI)
content.description: Pi Network is a social cryptocurrency and developer platform designed to make digital currency mining accessible to everyday people through mobile devices.

content.title: About XRP
content.description: XRP is a decentralized digital asset designed for high-performance global payments and efficient asset exchange on the XRP Ledger Layer 1 network.
